conviction_note: The pieces add up to a modest long (impact_sum +1.55). DOCN has beaten the top of its revenue guide in each of the last two quarters (Q2: $281.2m against a $272-274m guide) and its EPS guide by about double, and the CFO said 10 weeks into Q3 that he was 'highly confident' in the Q3 guide. Working against that: the bar already sits at the top of the guide ($306.7-307.2m) with a $0.41 EPS whisper, there is an 8.3-point put skew driven by a sector-wide neocloud credit scare, and there is real risk of an equity or financing announcement and a 2027 frame below the Street's top models. So p_up is held at 56 on an abs_move of 14, which gives +1.68, close to the findings' sum.
bar: Q3 revenue guide $304-307m, non-GAAP EPS $0.28-0.30, adj. EBITDA margin 38-39% (company 8-K, 2026-08-04, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001582961/000162828026052135/a2026-q2dopressrelease.htm). Two estimate sources agree: consensus revenue $306.66m / EPS $0.32 (Investing.com, 2026-11-02, https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/digitalocean-earnings-on-deck-as-ai-funding-questions-loom-93CH-4992298) and $307.2m / $0.33 with a $0.41 EPS whisper (Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 2026-10-26, https://finviz.com/news/408173/digitaloceans-ai-surge-faces-a-stiff-test-as-street-bets-beyond-guidance). FY26 guide $1.170-1.180bn; CEO: exit Q4 growing 35%+ and 2027 growth above 50% (not formal guidance). Street models 60-70% for 2027 per Investing.com. Revenue bar = top of the guide.
positioning_check: Short interest 8.7m shares, 7.4% of float, 2.4 days to cover, down 25% month on month, as of 2026-08-19 (Equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/docn/shortinterest). No October settlement figure was found. Earlier highs were 14.1% of float on 2026-03-31 (MarketBeat). Not a crowded short. Baseline: 25-delta skew +8.34 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.62, ATM IV 164.7%, event-implied move 13.11%. Run-up: -33.5% over 20 days, -8.3% over 5, -49.7% from the 52-week high, in the middle of a sector-wide neocloud credit selloff (CoreWeave CDS, Musk's 2026-10-26 comment, Microsoft's capex miss on 2026-10-28). The 2026-10-14 drop of -8.5% came on volume 91% below average (MarketBeat 2026-10-14).

findings.finding: On 2026-09-11, about 10 weeks into the 13-week Q3, CFO Matt Steinfort said in the $725m equipment-financing release that DigitalOcean 'remains highly confident in our guidance for Q3 and the full year 2026 as well as in our outlook for 2027'. That is an in-quarter company reaffirmation of the $304-307m Q3 guide and the 2027 50%+ frame, made after the 2026-08-01 GPU price increase and the MKC1 (Kansas City, B300) launch were already in the quarter. Consensus sits at the top of the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: DOCN beat its revenue guide top in Q1 2026 (stock +40.4%) and Q2 2026 (+1.35% on the print day, after a 2026-07-07 pre-release that moved it +4.32%). 6 of the last 8 prints closed up.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock fell from about $135 (late September) to $91 after this statement, on sector credit fears and with no company-specific negative news found. If the market were treating the quarter as at risk, the consensus would have moved below the top of the guide. It has not (revenue estimates are flat over 60 days per Investing.com). So the statement is in the price for the quarter, but the drawdown and the skew are not pricing a quarter miss. Lands inside the guided range, so small.
findings.independence: Same company voice as the 2026-08-04 8-K guide. Independent: the bar from two estimate sources sits at the top of the guide (Investing.com 2026-11-02; Earnings Whispers 2026-10-26).

findings.finding: The beat pattern is documented: Q2 2026 revenue was $281.2m against a $272-274m guide (+2.6% over the top), and non-GAAP EPS was $0.45 against a $0.20-0.23 guide. Q1 2026 EPS was $0.44 against $0.26 consensus. Q3 contains a full quarter of the on-demand and 12-month reserved GPU price increase effective 2026-08-01 (company blog 2026-07-21, citing 'strong demand for advanced GPU capacity'; Earnings Whispers calls it a ~30% increase) and the MKC1 Kansas City B300 region, live by 2026-08-04. A repeat beat of +1.5-2.5% would give revenue of about $311-314m against a $306.7-307.2m bar. The EPS whisper of $0.41 against $0.32-0.33 consensus means the EPS beat is already expected by the buy side.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A Q1 2026 beat and raise: +40.4%. A Q2 2026 beat of $7m over the guide top plus a FY raise: +1.35% (pre-released). 2025-11-05: +18.0%. 2025-08-05: +28.9%. Revenue beats have mostly been bought on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus revenue sits at the guide top ($306.7m), not above it, although the company beat the top by $7m last quarter and Q3 carries a price increase the guide may only partly include. If a repeat beat were priced, revenue consensus would sit near $312m. On EPS it is priced: the whisper is $0.41.
findings.independence: The price-increase fact comes from a different document: https://www.digitalocean.com/blog/price-changes-gpus (2026-07-21). The Q2 guide comes from the Q1 8-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001582961/000158296126000045/a2026-q1dopressrelease.htm. Peer pricing: Nebius raised on-demand H100 pricing 17-21% from 2026-10-01 (https://www.spheron.network/blog/nebius-gpu-price-hike-2026-h100-to-b300-rates-rise-up-to-21/).

findings.finding: The 2027 bar sits above management's frame. The CEO said 2027 growth would be above 50% (2026-08-04 8-K), while Investing.com's 2026-11-02 preview says 'some analysts model 60% to 70%' depending on capacity timing and on-demand pricing. Earnings Whispers says the Street 'bets beyond guidance'. If the print reiterates '50%+' without lifting it, the stock may read that as below the top-end models. A lift to 60%+ would be a large positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-05-06 print fell 13.8% (a guide-driven reaction). The Q1 2026 guide raise drew +40.4%. Guidance has driven the large moves on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: A stock down 50% from its high is not pricing 60-70% growth. But sell-side price targets (mean $173.80) still embed the top-end models, so a reiterated 50%+ could bring target cuts. The sign is genuinely two-sided, which is why this is sized small. The CFO's 2026-09-11 'highly confident in our outlook for 2027' is the counterweight, and the size is net of it.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 2026-10-26 (https://finviz.com/news/408173/digitaloceans-ai-surge-faces-a-stiff-test-as-street-bets-beyond-guidance), points the same way ('Street bets beyond guidance'). The CFO statement (finding 1's source) points against it.

findings.finding: Funding: UBS estimates DOCN needs about $4bn of incremental capital through mid-2029 to reach about 300 MW. The 10-Q shows $2.76bn of uncommenced co-location leases starting July 2026 to June 2028, $312.3m of 2026 converts due 2026-12-01 (conversion price $178.51, out of the money, so a cash repayment), cash of $767.0m and $406.7m of undrawn revolver at June 30. DOCN raised equity twice in 2026 ($888m follow-on in March, a 12.5m-share direct offering at $117.54 in July). What the money buys is answered: RPO of $894m (more than 10x a year earlier), 155 MW committed, and the $725m (+$300m accordion) equipment facility of 2026-09-11 funds 2027-28 capacity. So this is funding of visible demand, not distress. The residual risk is an equity or convert offering announced with or just after the print, at a price $26 below the July offering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: April 2026: shares slid on the upsized ~$800m offering (QuiverQuant). July 2026 direct offering at $117.54, alongside the note repurchase. The August 2025 convert offering: shares -10% intraday.
findings.why_not_priced: The 33% drawdown on sector credit fears is plausibly already pricing a funding overhang. A raise in the window would still be a fresh supply event. A print showing funded capacity could relieve the overhang instead. Net close to zero.
findings.independence: UBS capital estimate via Investing.com, 2026-11-02 (https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/digitalocean-earnings-on-deck-as-ai-funding-questions-loom-93CH-4992298). Financing facility: https://pulse2.com/digitalocean-secures-725-million-equipment-financing-facility-led-by-mufg-axos-bmo-and-wells-fargo-to-expand-ai-cloud-capacity/ (2026-09-11).

findings.finding: The October drawdown is identified as sector contagion rather than company news. Neocloud credit stress (CoreWeave CDS at distress levels, CoreWeave -36% in October, Nebius about -27%), Musk's 2026-10-26 'guppy-level death' remark and Microsoft's 2026-10-28 capex below estimates all hit the group. DOCN fell -8.5% on 2026-10-14 on volume 91% below average and -10.1% on 2026-10-16, with no company release. DOCN's AI customer ARR is $234m of $1,125m total ARR (about 21%), so most of the business is the core developer cloud, which these credit fears do not touch. The print is the first company data point since the scare.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print came off a sector-driven drawdown of this size. The 2025-11-05 print (+18.0%) came after an AI-bubble scare in tech.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference, not a document, and the 8.3-point put skew says the option market expects the contagion to persist through the print. If the market had separated DOCN from the levered neoclouds, DOCN would not have fallen as much as CoreWeave and IREN over the same 20 days. Sized small.
findings.independence: Sector credit selloff: https://www.openingbelldailynews.com/p/coreweave-iren-nebius-stock-down-today-oct-22-2026 (2026-10-22). DOCN's own volume on the drop: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-digitalocean-nyse-docn-shares-down-85-whats-next-2026-10-14/ (2026-10-14).

findings.finding: Counterparties that reported after DOCN last spoke show inference and cloud demand still ahead of supply, and GPU pricing rising. AWS Q3 2026 revenue grew +39% (its sixth straight quarter of acceleration). Azure grew +48%, with Microsoft saying demand exceeds capacity. Nebius raised on-demand H100/H200/B200/B300 prices 17-21% from 2026-10-01. That is a proxy positive for DOCN's AI ARR and on-demand GPU pricing, which matters for the Q4 guide (exit growth 35%+).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: DOCN's 2026 guide raises (Q1, Q2) came alongside AI ARR growth (+212% in Q2). The Q1 raise drew +40%.
findings.why_not_priced: These are hyperscaler and peer prints, and DOCN fell alongside them on credit, not demand, grounds. The Q4 guide is where it would show. If priced, DOCN would have bounced with hyperscaler beats. It did not (-4.8% on 2026-10-29). It is a proxy, and only the ~21% AI part of ARR is directly exposed, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Proxy. Nebius price increase: https://www.spheron.network/blog/nebius-gpu-price-hike-2026-h100-to-b300-rates-rise-up-to-21/. Azure: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/neocloud-stocks-drop-after-microsoft-revises-capex-down.html. DOCN's own GPU price increase: https://www.digitalocean.com/blog/price-changes-gpus.

findings.finding: Capacity-delivery risk, the swing factor UBS named for Q3. UBS (July 2026) said Richmond was near full and that the Kansas City MKC1 ramp was the key Q3 revenue swing. MKC1 then had a critical incident on 2026-08-19: about 8.5 hours of DOKS GPU nodes NotReady and inference endpoints unavailable, with GPU Droplets impacted beyond resolution and affected customers contacted directly. Microsoft's 2026-10-28 commentary says partners are taking longer to deliver data-center capacity. Any slip in the 155 MW schedule would weigh on Q4 and 2027 more than on Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not observed on a print. The company has said capacity came 'on or ahead of schedule' (2026-08-04 8-K).
findings.why_not_priced: The incident was a single 8.5-hour event inside a quarter the CFO later reaffirmed (2026-09-11). The Microsoft read-through is a proxy. Small.
findings.independence: UBS note via search snippet (https://www.itiger.com/news/2573965020). MKC1 incident also on https://isdown.app/status/digitalocean/incidents/640933-degraded-performance-in-mkc1. The CFO statement of 2026-09-11 cuts against this, and the size is net of it.

findings.finding: RPO lumpiness and concentration. Q2 RPO was $893.8m ($365.9m within 12 months), driven by multiple nine-figure deals. The top 25 customers were about 20% of Q2 revenue against 9% a year earlier, and customers over $1M a month were 23%. Earnings Whispers flags that management calls RPO lumpy and that a flat or lower figure 'would need explanation'. Q2 also set a record of $93m new ARR, a high comparison for Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-07-07 RPO pre-release (above $800m) drew +4.3%. RPO has been bought when it jumped. No print yet has shown flat RPO.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews anchor on another record new ARR and continued RPO growth (Earnings Whispers). If the market expected flat RPO, previews would not set the bar beyond guidance. The sign is unknown: this is a risk with no evidence that Q3 bookings were weak.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 2026-10-26 (https://finviz.com/news/408173/digitaloceans-ai-surge-faces-a-stiff-test-as-street-bets-beyond-guidance). Shares the 10-Q with finding 4, on different lines.

About $153m of principal stayed outstanding after the 2026-07-23 repurchase of $471.8m, which is up to about 3.9m shares of possible Q3 conversions. The Q3 diluted share guide is about 126-127m.
findings.why_not_priced: Most likely inside the guided diluted share count. Sized near zero.

baseline_tension: The modest long runs against an 8.3-point put skew and a -33.5% 20-day run-up. Both are explained by sector credit contagion rather than company data, and the company's own documents (CFO reaffirmation, $894m RPO, beat history) point the other way. p_up is therefore held at 56, not higher.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the money funds visible demand ($894m RPO, 155 MW committed, the $725m equipment facility), so the funding finding moved from -0.5 to -0.25. The only residual is the risk of an in-window offering.
Lesson 3 (caveat reaches the number): the 2027-bar finding moved from -1.0 to -0.5, net of the CFO's 2026-09-11 'highly confident in our outlook for 2027'.

Lesson 5 (proxies small, the drawdown cause is not evidence): the sector-contagion positioning finding moved from +0.5 to +0.25, the hyperscaler/GPU-pricing proxy from +0.75 to +0.5, and the Microsoft capacity-delivery read-through from -0.5 to -0.25.
Lesson 7 (sign against skew): p_up moved from 57 to 56 for the 8.3-point put skew; abs_move stays at 14.

Lessons 1, 6 and 9 left standing: the bar is sourced to the guide plus two agreeing estimates, the reaction history shows beats bought (6 of 8 up), and the AI share of ARR (~21%) is noted in the proxy finding.
